notes: Single-pipeline competency (C-15759d2a): persist a vocabulary object whose parallel word-to-index / index-to-word maps are exact inverses and whose size equals the embedding row count. The agent authors a Vocab dataclass module (the pickle module path must survive unpickling inside the checker), a reusable CLI builder, and the three artifacts. Hidden corpora probe the frequency-then-lexicographic ordering rule, an all-blank (zero-token) corpus, all-tie frequencies, and byte-level determinism of re-runs. difficulty hard is the competency's stated floor; adversarial/hidden at 2 for the edge corpora, quantitative at 1 (exact ordering + size agreement, no floats in the objective).
